requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The Out-of-Box Experience (OOBE) at 123.hp.com should present only one consistent printer reference name to the customer for HP OfficeJet Pro 9010 series, reducing the current four references to just one.

requirements.Requirement: Printer able to run all new/current EM / market segment media
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The printer must reliably print on all new and current EM (Evaluation Media) and media types for each market segment, meeting intervention specifications for different media and climatic conditions on the Manhattan platform.

requirements.Requirement: Product can be placed and work on uneven surface ( sofa , table cloth , carpet …)
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The product must operate correctly when placed on uneven surfaces such as sofas, table cloths, or carpets, without input tray sensor flag breakage or similar failures.

requirements.Requirement: Tilt left and right each while printing
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The printer must be able to function without failure if tilted left or right up to 20 degrees during printing.

requirements.Requirement: Put printer on trolley and print
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The printer must maintain print quality and function correctly when placed on a moving trolley during operation.
